project_title: City-Wide AI ANPR Trajectory Tracking & Urban Traffic Analytics Engine

theme_strategy.rationale: Command & control center environments for law enforcement and traffic operators demand high contrast dark mode (#090D16 base) to minimize operator eye fatigue during 24/7 shifts and ensure critical alerts (amber/crimson) pop instantly.

hierarchy.h1_hero_dashboard_title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight font-display text-slate-100
hierarchy.mono_data_readout: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wide text-cyan-400 font-medium

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / COMMAND CONTROL TACTICAL

layout_strategy.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 bg-[#0D1322] border-r border-white/10 z-40 hidden md:block
layout_strategy.header: h-16 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0D1322]/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-30 px-6 flex items-center justify-between

auth_page.description: Tactical command portal login with role selection (Traffic Operator, Investigator, Urban Planner, System Admin), MFA badge simulation, and system status indicator.

live_dashboard.description: Real-time ANPR streaming feed, interactive map snippet, KPI widgets (Detections/min, Active Alerts, Camera Uptime, Peak Flow), active alerts panel.

trajectory_tracker.description: Search by license plate or vehicle description, chronological interactive route map with directional arrows, hop-by-hop timeline, dwell time calculator, speed estimation between nodes, PDF/CSV export.

camera_network_map.description: City-wide Leaflet/Mapbox interactive node network, online/offline status toggle, FOV direction indicators, traffic density heatmap overlay, quick node diagnostic drawer.

blacklist_alerts.description: Blacklisted vehicle registry (stolen, wanted, uninsured), real-time alert feed with sound toggle, acknowledge/escalate/close incident workflow, camera snapshot thumbnail viewer.

detection_feed.description: High-throughput streaming detection table with plate crop preview, OCR confidence badge, camera location link, vehicle make/color classification filters.

traffic_analytics.description: Origin-Destination matrix flows, congestion heatmaps by hour, average speed trends per corridor, vehicle category pie charts using Recharts.

admin_management.description: User role management, camera API key provisioning, AI OCR threshold configuration, immutable audit trail log.

motion_and_interactions.live_pulse: relative before:absolute before:inset-0 before:rounded-full before:animate-ping before:bg-emerald-400/50

map_and_gis_guidelines.library: Leaflet / react-leaflet or custom SVG interactive GIS grid
map_and_gis_guidelines.theme: Dark Matter / CartoDB Dark map tile style
map_and_gis_guidelines.markers: Custom SVG pulse markers with camera status colors (Emerald = Online, Amber = Congested, Red = Alert/Blacklist Hit)
map_and_gis_guidelines.trajectory_polyline: Animated dashed SVG cyan polyline `#00F0FF` with glowing glow shadow and directional arrows along vector points.

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, tabs, inputs, modal triggers, and data key values MUST include data-testid with kebab-case naming.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Build a production-grade React JS application using modern Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Ensure dark mode styling is crisp with dark slate panels, cyan border highlights, and dark-tinted glass overlays.
Never leave blank or non-interactive placeholders; include working mock data generators for live plate reads, map coordinates, and alerts.
Add toast feedback via sonner when acknowledging alerts, exporting trajectories, or modifying blacklists.
Maintain strict data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Never default to centered layouts or plain Bootstrap columns; use tactical bento panels, top metric tickers, and tabbed viewports.
